ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-30-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioner: Carperleen Lee, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Doris Lee Love.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-16-2004 Reset To Dec-30-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerks: M. Vallejo/R. Edwards, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioner: Doris Lee Love, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.

The Court continued this matter to December 30, 2004 in order for the proof of publication to be filed.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-02-2004 Reset To Dec-16-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
Petitioner: Doris Lee Love, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.

The Court advised the petitioner that since there is no proof of publication on file, this matter is continued to December 16, 2004 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
